'''Arachni's Scythe''' is a [[Unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] obtained from the [[Arachni's Spoils]] chest that spawns after killing [[Arachni]] in [[Arachni's Haunt]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] 20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Insectoid Scythe]] [[dye]]d purple.
